currentTask: M11 native permission owner proven; guest approvals gated by host lock
message: A brand-new macOS 27 candidate from commit df51458b passed console login, clean-keychain, reboot, and pinned-tool setup. The native Peekaboo Lab Host launched through LaunchServices as the intended long-lived manual bridge. The mini's clawd console then returned to its login screen, so the guest's Screen Recording and Accessibility toggles cannot be completed until the host session is unlocked.

P02.detail: Matched non-USB macOS 15 clone passes. Three USB trials show: empty XHCI stalls before vm.start; removing the synthetic keyboard does not help; preconfiguring the mWave instead stalls in Accessory Access registration with no prompt. Tart capacity is clean and the known signed lab binary is restored.
P02.blocker: The remaining acceptance test requires an onsite mWave keypress. macOS 27 beta Accessory Access also fails to complete registration remotely despite Tart being foreground and the console unlocked.

R01.phase: macOS 26 legacy managed Accessibility is visually on but functionally absent
R01.detail: The exact signed launcher and engine appear in Accessibility with managed-on switches, but the independent oracle finds no user or system TCC record on macOS 26.5.2. This matches Apple's macOS 26.2 deprecation of grants through the legacy PPPC payload.

nextTasks.label: Publish exact launcher and engine identities

R01.blocker: Use a macOS 15 managed base or publish Apple's declarative app-settings Accessibility configuration for macOS 26.2+.

updates.title: M11 native permission owner proven; host console relocked
updates.message: Fresh-clone setup passed and the signed native Peekaboo Lab Host now owns the stable manual bridge. Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Remote Management remain because the mini's clawd desktop unexpectedly returned to its login screen.

updates.title: M11 permission ownership isolated
updates.message: The clean macOS 27 candidate proved standalone SSH launches cannot become a reusable Screen Recording identity. A stable Peekaboo Lab Host app now owns the TCC boundary; fresh immutable-source validation is next.

updates.title: M11 candidate provisioned; privacy approvals next
updates.message: Pinned tool provisioning now works from the clean macOS 27 source. The active candidate is ready for one-time Screen Recording, Accessibility, and Remote Management approval.

updates.title: M11 selector driver published; automation-base work begins
updates.message: PR #1206 contains the fail-closed macOS 27 selector driver. Clone evidence is preserved, disposable capacity is clear, and M11 is now building the reusable Desktop Automation Base.

updates.title: M11 exposed a missing macOS 27 automation base
updates.message: The core VM survived. The problem is base role separation: the only macOS 27 source is clean and carries stale Apple Account state, while UI automation needs a separately prepared, permissioned desktop base. Driver hardening continues while that base task is made explicit.

updates.title: M11 macOS 27 selector work resumed
updates.message: P02 is parked at its onsite boundary. The lab is now provisioning a fresh macOS 27 desktop clone so selector evidence is current rather than inherited from last week’s stopped VM.

updates.title: P02 remote work complete; physical mWave proof remains
updates.message: Remote testing reached the safe boundary. The managed clone and network are healthy without USB; every USB-controller variant stops before guest networking, and Apple’s pre-start API stalls before authorization completes. No leases or orphan VMs remain, the mWave is back on the host, and the known signed Tart app is restored.

updates.title: P02 empty-controller cause isolated; testing Apple’s pre-start path
updates.message: Removing Tart’s synthetic keyboard did not change the timeout. The next remote-safe experiment follows Apple’s other supported route: authorize the mWave first and place it on the virtual controller before the VM starts.

updates.title: P02 mWave-only boot trial is running
updates.message: A third matched clone is starting with the passthrough controller enabled and Tart’s synthetic USB keyboard removed. This isolates whether two virtual USB keyboard paths are preventing the macOS 15 guest from booting.

updates.title: P02 USB startup failure isolated by matched control
updates.message: The non-USB clone passed boot, networking, MDM, and lane admission; the otherwise identical USB-enabled clone timed out before guest IP. No orphan or capacity leak remains. Investigation now moves USB registration after startup.

updates.title: P02 non-USB control passed end to end
updates.message: A fresh managed macOS 15 clone passed boot, networking, desktop bootstrap, MDM enrollment, all three profile acknowledgements, and lane verification. The matched mWave USB-enabled startup is next.

updates.title: P02 remote USB A/B proof started
updates.message: The signed USB Tart path is merged and the mWave is attached. Remote work is now preserving archive isolation, releasing the expired Tart slot, and comparing matched non-USB and USB-enabled boots before the final onsite keystroke.

updates.title: P02 Apple capability and signed deployment proven
updates.message: Apple confirmed Claim USB Accessory for the dedicated App ID. The generated profile contains com.apple.developer.accessory-access.usb, the signed Tart app validates on the mini, and PR #1196 is carrying the owned USB-enabled lease option through required review.

updates.title: P02 App ID created; managed entitlement request required
updates.message: The dedicated macOS App ID exists and the Tart signing package is ready. Apple's API and Xcode both reject automatic Accessory Access activation, confirming that the Account Holder must submit the managed-capability request in the web portal.

updates.title: D06 identity-scoped admission merged
updates.message: PR #1191 merged after the automated reviewer retry and all required checks passed. Randomized macOS 15 clones can coexist while shared macOS 26 identity protection remains serialized.

updates.title: P02 USB passthrough implementation ready for entitlement proof
updates.message: Tart builds with a new macOS 27 USB passthrough flag, and CrabBox now carries an explicit opt-in through YAML, environment, and CLI configuration. Provider/configuration tests pass; Apple signing entitlement and physical accessory selection remain.

updates.title: P02 supported USB passthrough route identified
updates.message: The macOS 27 mini exposes Apple's new physical USB passthrough API. Tart 2.32.1 lacks a flag and the host currently has no USB accessory attached; implementation can proceed without repeating the rejected VNC or USB-only experiments.
